title.zh: AMD与英特尔达成合作，将oneDNN定为PyTorch中x86加速默认开源库
title.en: AMD与英特尔达成合作，将oneDNN定为PyTorch中x86加速默认开源库

current_state.zh: AMD and Intel have agreed to make oneDNN the default open-source library for x86 acceleration in PyTorch, aiming to simplify AI development and optimize AI compute on x86 CPU platforms.
current_state.en: AMD and Intel have agreed to make oneDNN the default open-source library for x86 acceleration in PyTorch, aiming to simplify AI development and optimize AI compute on x86 CPU platforms.
